title: Search Broadly, Seek Evidence on Both Sides, Decide Narrowly: Evidence-Admissible GraphRAG for Longitudinal Clinical Event Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.22062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal clinical event-relation verification determines whether a patient record supports a specified relation among two or more clinical events. This task is challenging because evidence is distributed across structured records, notes, laboratory trajectories, encounters, and time, while negation, temporal mismatch, repeated documentation, and conflicting findings can make retrieved information appear relevant without establishing the relation.   We present MedEventGraph-RAG, an evidence-admissible framework that represents event occurrences in a patient-specific graph and links each occurrence to source evidence, including structured rows, note spans, timestamps, and numerical trajectories. Given a verification query specifying events, relation, and clinical scope, the graph guides discovery of candidate event chains and retrieves evidence from both supporting and contradicting sides. translated_title: 广泛搜索，双侧求证，窄化判定：面向纵向临床事件验证的证据可受理图检索增强生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22062v1 公告类型：新 摘要：纵向临床事件关系验证旨在确定患者记录是否支持两个或多个临床事件之间指定的关系。这项任务具有挑战性，因为证据分散在结构化记录、笔记、实验室轨迹、就诊记录和时间中，而否定、时间不匹配、重复记录和冲突发现可能使检索到的信息看似相关，却无法确立关系。我们提出了MedEventGraph-RAG，一个证据可受理框架，该框架在患者特定图中表示事件发生，并将每次发生链接到源证据，包括结构化行、笔记片段、时间戳和数值轨迹。给定一个指定事件、关系和临床范围的验证查询，该图引导候选事件链的发现，并从支持和反对两侧检索证据。一个查询特定的证据契约过滤不可靠信息。
tldr: 本文提出MedEventGraph-RAG，一种证据可受理的图检索增强生成框架，通过患者特定事件图链接源证据，并从正反两侧检索，以解决纵向临床事件验证中证据分散和冲突的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MedEventGraph-RAG, an evidence-admissible GraphRAG framework that links event occurrences to source evidence in a patient-specific graph and retrieves evidence from both supporting and contradicting sides, addressing the challenge of distributed and conflicting evidence in longitudinal clinical event verification.
